title: Outlier Treatment and Capping
description: Remediation strategies for extreme numerical values including winsorization, trimming, and transform stabilization.
conditions: Numerical features containing verified valid extreme values that distort linear estimators
Algorithms sensitive to scale and variance (Linear Regression, K-Means, Neural Networks)
Data cannot be discarded without losing valuable entity context
recommended_methods: Winsorization at 1st and 99th percentiles (or 5th / 95th for extreme skew)
Logarithmic or Box-Cox transformation to compress right-tailed distributions
selection_rules: If data is right-skewed strictly positive (revenue, dosage), apply Log1p transformation first before capping
If extreme values represent data entry errors, trim/remove records
If extreme values represent genuine rare phenomena, winsorize to percentile limits rather than dropping
limitations: Winsorization introduces artificial spikes at boundary percentiles
Trimming reduces sample size and induces survivorship bias
